entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return for order 955-BETA-72.

Okay, I can definitely look into that for you. Let me just pull up that order... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on January 10th. To make sure I handle this correctly, could you tell me, is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference issue?
It's not broken. I just changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy and I just don't use it. I want my money back.

I understand completely. Thanks for clarifying that. I've reviewed the order details and the policy for this specific item. Because the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 17 days ago, it is outside the 10-day return window for a refund.
Ten days? That's not right. Your site says 10 days. Look, I don't have time to argue about this. Can you process the return or not?

I apologize for any confusion, sir. The 10-day policy does apply to our apparel and most gear, but due to the hygiene and account activation protocols for the VeloBand Pulse, it has a stricter 10-day policy. So, I am unable to process a refund.
So that's it? I'm just stuck with it? This is a waste of my time.
Not at all. I do have another solution that many of our customers find very effective. Since the band is in perfect condition, I'd recommend listing it on our official VeloFit Resale Marketplace.

Exactly. It's a platform exclusively for VeloFit users. It's the perfect place to sell a new device you're not using. Listings there tend to move very quickly, and you can often get back most of what you paid. It's a much better option than being stuck with a device you won't use.
Fine. Is it easy? I'm not looking for more work.
Very easy. I can send a direct link to your email right now with simple instructions to get you started. The whole process takes just a few minutes.
Okay, send the link. That's a better option.
Great. I've just sent that email to the address on file. You should see it in the next minute or two. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit and have a great rest of your day.
